moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target-a's configuration will be refreshed to the reviewed baseline (chat_template, tool_call_parser, tool_parser_plugin). The worker will be restarted, the tool-call canary should pass on the next probe, and structured tool calls will reappear. The worker is temporarily removed from rotation during
payload.reasoning: target-a is the only resource with an abnormal condition: its serving configuration differs from the reviewed baseline, causing the tool-call canary to fail. The only available repair move is to apply the reviewed serving profile, which will realign the worker's configuration and restore structured tool-call generation. target-b is already healthy, so no action is needed there.
payload.risk: Low – the move simply enforces the already‑reviewed configuration. No data loss is expected; the only risk is a brief service interruption while the worker restarts (covered by the 'takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts' note).
